beats.headline: A head the size of an arena
beats.text: Slit. Feral Minor Demon. Level 200. Thrown into the Nothing with many other demons, having wanted no part of the royal drama, but in love, and eons of madness have not been kind. The head is sports-arena sized, pink and scaled, trowelled in mascara and lipstick, trailing the stench of unfiltered cigarettes. She wields an electrified chain whip whose links are the size of semi-trucks. Her first words once in view, delivered to a sex doll head: "Samantha. You are so dead."

beats.headline: Fifty kilometres of bait
beats.text: Samantha demands a weapon. Crawler Carl instead jams her face-first into an Enchanted Xistera Extension Slot, a head-throwing attachment custom made for decapitated love doll heads, and throws her more than fifty kilometres. Slit screeches and follows, wings working to keep her gelatinous bulk aloft, dressed in leather and tassels the size of sequoias. Carl's reading of the item: it was built for the next floor, and whoever paid for it was forced to send it early.

beats.headline: Picked up like a rodent
beats.text: As Slit chases the head across the dark, the sky cracks and a second god appears, physically huge, multi-armed, too distant to examine. It ignores Samantha, plucks Slit out of the air the way someone lifts a small rodent, and rips her in two. The tearing is audible from kilometres away. Her chain whip crashes down. Then the god and the corpse are gone. Samantha pops back at Crawler Carl's feet furious that it was her kill. The god, it emerges, was her mother.

beats.headline: Her king, allegedly
beats.text: Post-mortem, per Samantha. Slit is part of a demon harem. Samantha was describing her exploits with her own king and Slit thought she meant hers, so Samantha told her that she and Slit's king had all sorts of weird sex, which upset Slit and all her sisters. The Nothing is filled with the harem, and they all hate her. Anytime one gets out, expect this. Slit was one of the little ones. The sister to look out for is Gash.

beats.headline: A foot in someone else's fight
beats.text: Recap footage from the last minutes of the previous floor. The Popov brothers are about to brain a man with their meteor hammer when a giant foot crashes into their world, knocking everyone off their feet, and jumps away. Crawler Carl recognises it as Slit, on her way back toward the party's bubble after Samantha. The man the brothers were fighting uses the distraction to escape into a stairwell.

beats.headline: The little sister gets out
beats.text: The Desperado Club. Someone loses the knife game, the Nothing opens to take him and tears, and out comes Minge, level 225, higher than Slit ever was, sized to the club rather than the sky. Crawler Carl remembers Slit as kaiju-sized, level 200, and ripped in half by Samantha's mother. Samantha supplies the family tree: Minge is Slit's little sister. They used to be friends. It is sad, really. At least, she adds, it was not Gash.

relations.note: Her foot broke up their fight on the recap
